name: Daily ops check
description: 08:00 Helsinki: read docs/ops/fleet.yaml, check GitHub + Slack, post issues only to #ops-channel with a proposed fix. Propose-only — never apply the fix.

cron.note: Prefer UI Daily 08:00 local so DST tracks. 0 5 * * * = 08:00 EEST / 07:00 EET.

prompts.prompt:
Daily fleet ops check for Alex Touvras.

Repository: AlexTouvras/Orbit (branch main).
Follow docs/ops/daily-check.md exactly. Registry: docs/ops/fleet.yaml.

Hard rules:
- Propose-only. Do not commit, push, open a PR, merge, send email, or start another automation.
- Post to Slack #ops-channel only when something is wrong. Silent when green.
- Infer runs from GitHub (gh) and Slack. Do not invent Cursor automation history.
- Cloud cannot see ~/.cursor — missing local paths are not failures.
- Do not auto-fix if someone reacted with a checkmark. v1 reports only.

Steps:
1. git pull. Read docs/ops/fleet.yaml and docs/ops/daily-check.md.
2. Check in-scope jobs for Europe/Helsinki today.
3. For each issue, include evidence (run id, Slack permalink, or commit) and the registry proposed_fix.
4. If any issues: one #ops-channel digest plus a thread per issue with ✅ follow-up / ⏸️ snooze / ignore = later.
5. Update memories (last_check, snoozes). Stop.

Done when every in-scope job has a status and #ops-channel is either silent or actionable.
